answer.reason: The verses tell of events at Mizpah of Gilead: Israel's camp against Ammon and Jephthah's return to his house.

clauses.english: was where the Israelites encamped when Ammon gathered in Gilead
clauses.quote: the children of Israel assembled themselves together, and encamped in Mizpeh

clauses.english: was where Jephthah's daughter came out with timbrels to meet him
clauses.quote: his daughter came out to meet him with timbrels and with dances

doubts: HOS 5:1 names Mizpah beside Tabor and may mean a different place, so it was left out.
